goal.en: Ask for an object you need and say thank you.
goal.de: Bitte um einen Gegenstand, den du brauchst, und bedanke dich.

base_manuscript.inheritance: full dialogue, teaching, P/I/R items, answer criteria, help and feedback retained verbatim; overlay is additive

source_contract.title: 필요한 것을 부탁하기
source_contract.teach: 요청 덩어리 먼저; 별도 장면에서 행동 대상 을·를을 시범; 주세요와 -으세요의 모든 활용을 한 번에 시험하지 않음
source_contract.practice: 물건을 고른 뒤 요청하고 상대의 건넴에 반응
source_contract.transfer: 새 물건을 요청하되 그 이름을 먼저 익힘; 말하기 불가 시 선택 대안

context.ko: 이번에는 물이 필요해요. 상대에게 물건이 있고 건네줄 수 있어요.
context.en: You need 물. Your partner has it and can hand it to you.
context.de: Du brauchst 물. Die andere Person hat es und kann es dir geben.

prompt.ko: 필요한 물건을 부탁하고, 받은 뒤 감사해요. 두 행동을 한 번에 시험하지 않고 차례로 해요.
prompt.en: Ask for the object, then thank your partner after the handover. These are checked in separate turns.
prompt.de: Bitte um den Gegenstand und bedanke dich nach dem Überreichen. Die beiden Handlungen werden nacheinander geprüft.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 앞 명사의 물건을 달라는 부탁 덩어리

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 먼저 물건 이름과 주세요를 말해요. 감사는 받은 다음 차례예요.
level1.en: First say the object’s name and 주세요. Thanks comes after the handover.
level1.de: Nenne zuerst den Gegenstand mit 주세요. Der Dank kommt nach dem Überreichen.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 받기 전에는 필요한 물건을 부탁해요. 다른 물건이 왔다면 확인 도움으로 돌아가요.
wrong_feedback.en: Ask for what you need before receiving it. If a different object arrives, return to confirmation support.
wrong_feedback.de: Bitte zuerst um das, was du brauchst. Kommt ein anderer Gegenstand an, nutze die Hilfe zur Klärung.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept noun(을/를) 주세요 / 부탁해요 with appropriate meaning. 고마워요 and 감사합니다 both thanks, judged relative to relationship. Handover state must be observed before thanks turn; no simulated saved possession.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 그림 속 인물이 물을 마셔요. 실제로 마실 필요는 없어요.
context.en: The person in the picture drinks 물. You do not have to drink anything yourself.
context.de: Die Person im Bild trinkt 물. Du musst selbst nichts trinken.

prompt.ko: 그림의 행동과 대상을 한 문장으로 말해요.
prompt.en: Describe the action and its object in one sentence.
prompt.de: Beschreibe die Handlung und ihren Gegenstand in einem Satz.

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 무엇을 마시는지 말해요. 물+을, 차+를은 따로 배운 형태예요.
level1.en: Say what is being drunk. 물+을 and 차+를 are separately taught forms.
level1.de: Sage, was getrunken wird. 물+을 und 차+를 sind getrennt gelernte Formen.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 물 주세요는 부탁이에요. 여기서는 이미 보이는 마시는 행동을 설명해요. 조사 생략은 뜻과 목표 형태를 따로 남겨요.
wrong_feedback.en: 물 주세요 is a request. Here you describe the drinking action already shown. If a particle is omitted, record meaning and target form separately.
wrong_feedback.de: 물 주세요 ist eine Bitte. Hier beschreibst du die gezeigte Handlung. Bei ausgelassener Partikel werden Bedeutung und Zielform getrennt festgehalten.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept object+을/를 마셔요. Omission or topic construction may communicate action; mark object particle unobserved rather than communication wrong. No scoring of real ingestion.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 상대가 무엇을 하면 되는지 기다려요. 이번 행동은 보기예요.
context.en: Your partner waits for an invitation to look.
context.de: Die andere Person wartet auf die Aufforderung zum Schauen.

prompt.en: Give the polite invitation you learned in the model.
prompt.de: Gib die höfliche Aufforderung aus dem Beispiel.

level1.de: Erinnere dich mithilfe des Handlungsbildes an den ganzen Ausdruck.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 부탁하는 행동이 달라요. 지금은 물건을 달라는 장면이 아니에요. 동작을 다시 확인해요.
wrong_feedback.en: That asks for a different action. Check which action the partner is waiting for.
wrong_feedback.de: Das fordert zu einer anderen Handlung auf. Prüfe, welche Handlung gemeint ist.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 보세요/앉으세요 and appropriate polite equivalent for the exact action; target -(으)세요 separately observed. Speech optional; phrase selection = recognition, no productive credit.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 전달할 말이 잘 들리지 않았어요. 상대가 다시 말할 수 있어요.
context.en: You could not hear the message. The partner can repeat it.
context.de: Du konntest die Mitteilung nicht hören. Die andere Person kann sie wiederholen.

prompt.en: Ask the partner to say it again.
prompt.de: Bitte die andere Person, es noch einmal zu sagen.

wrong_feedback.ko: 부탁하는 행동이 달라요. 지금은 물건을 달라는 장면이 아니에요. 동작을 다시 확인해요.
wrong_feedback.en: That asks for a different action. Check which action the partner is waiting for.
wrong_feedback.de: Das fordert zu einer anderen Handlung auf. Prüfe, welche Handlung gemeint ist.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 보세요/앉으세요 and appropriate polite equivalent for the exact action; target -(으)세요 separately observed. Speech optional; phrase selection = recognition, no productive credit.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

items.evidence_scope: open response: practice/portfolio; independent axes only with qualified evaluator and raw evidence
items.delay_policy: R: propose at least24h after last relevant exposure, report actual elapsed time; exposure in any unit carries over; later same-target R is not fresh cold recall

context.ko: 전달할 말이 잘 들리지 않았어요. 상대가 다시 말할 수 있어요.
context.en: You could not hear the message. The partner can repeat it.
context.de: Du konntest die Mitteilung nicht hören. Die andere Person kann sie wiederholen.

prompt.en: Ask the partner to say it again.
prompt.de: Bitte die andere Person, es noch einmal zu sagen.

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.en: Use the repeat request from A1.1-01.
level1.de: Verwende die Bitte um Wiederholung aus A1.1-01.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

wrong_feedback.ko: 지금은 앉기·보기가 아니라 말의 반복이 필요해요.
wrong_feedback.en: Here you need repeated words rather than sitting or looking.
wrong_feedback.de: Hier brauchst du eine Wiederholung der Worte.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Actual later probe of A1.1-01 repair, not future link only. Same utterance is repeated after request. Recency/help from01carries over.

assisted.ko: 도움을 받아 이 활동을 함께 마쳤어요. 다른 예는 준비되면 해 봐요.
assisted.en: You completed this activity with support. Try another example when you are ready.
assisted.de: Du hast diese Aufgabe mit Hilfe abgeschlossen. Probiere ein weiteres Beispiel, wenn du bereit bist.

independent.ko: 이 예는 시범 없이 확인했어요. 다른 날 새로운 상황에서도 다시 해 봐요.
independent.en: You checked this example without a model. Try it in a new setting another day.
independent.de: Du hast dieses Beispiel ohne Vorlage bearbeitet. Probiere es an einem anderen Tag in einer neuen Situation.

audio_unavailable.ko: 지금은 소리를 재생할 수 없어요. 글과 그림으로 계속하거나 나중에 다시 들어요.
audio_unavailable.en: Audio is unavailable right now. Continue with text and pictures, or listen later.
audio_unavailable.de: Der Ton ist gerade nicht verfügbar. Mach mit Text und Bildern weiter oder höre später noch einmal zu.

pause.ko: 여기서 잠시 쉬어도 괜찮아요. 돌아오면 같은 차례에서 이어가요.
pause.en: You can take a break here. When you return, continue from the same turn.
pause.de: Du kannst hier eine Pause machen. Wenn du zurückkommst, geht es an derselben Stelle weiter.

resume.ko: 돌아왔네요. 놓아 둔 답과 도움 상태를 확인하고 이어가요.
resume.en: Welcome back. Check your previous response and any help you used, then continue.
resume.de: Willkommen zurück. Sieh dir deine bisherige Antwort und die verwendete Hilfe an und mach dann weiter.

save_failed.ko: 아직 저장을 확인하지 못했어요. 지금 답은 유지한 채 다시 시도해요.
save_failed.en: Saving has not been confirmed yet. Keep your response and try again.
save_failed.de: Das Speichern ist noch nicht bestätigt. Deine Antwort bleibt stehen; versuche es erneut.

revisit.ko: 이미 본 장면이에요. 다시 보아도 보상이나 공정이 중복 생성되지 않아요.
revisit.en: You have seen this scene before. Replaying it does not grant another reward or construction step.
revisit.de: Du kennst diese Szene bereits. Beim erneuten Ansehen erhältst du keine weitere Belohnung und keinen zusätzlichen Bauabschnitt.

response_conditions.assisted: only after supported task is resolved
response_conditions.independent: only if the eligible item met its criteria without model/hint; not all modalities
response_conditions.resume: only after original state is actually restored

story.spoiler_guard: Use only revealed facts. First book has no completed Sarangchae; first 집 remains practice draft until original readiness is confirmed.

review.original_review_scope: existing manuscript reviews and same-byte source; not human/native/device approval
